name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
description: Credit-linked subsidy program to generate self-employment micro-enterprises in non-farm rural sectors.

name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME)
description: Provides financial, technical, and business support for micro food processing enterprises under One District One Product (ODOP).

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
nodal_agency: Department of Financial Services / MUDRA Bank
required_documents: Quotation of Machinery / Items to be purchased
description: Collateral-free micro financing for small businesses across Shishu, Kishore, and Tarun loan buckets.

name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - NRLM (Micro Enterprise Support)

eligibility_criteria.target_group: Self-Help Group (SHG) members and rural women entrepreneurs

description: Subsidized interest loans and revolving funds for SHG-affiliated women entrepreneurs embarking on micro-enterprises.

name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
nodal_agency: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
interest_subvention: 3% per annum up to ₹2 Crore for 7 years

eligibility_criteria.target_group: Agri-entrepreneurs, FPOs, SHGs, Primary Agricultural Credit Societies

description: Medium-long term debt financing facility for investment in viable projects for post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets.
